title.narrative: Strengthening capacities to enhance the identification, conservation, protection, valorization, and management of tangible heritage in Iraq, specifically World Heritage sites

description.narrative: The Work Plan aims to strengthen capacities to enhance the identification, conservation, protection, valorization, and management of tangible heritage in Iraq with a focus on the World Heritage properties and in particular of the three properties currently included on the List of World Heritage in Danger. Technical assistance will be provided to the national and local authorities, most importantly to the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Antiquities and the State Board of Antiquities and Heritage, to ensure the effective implementation of World Heritage Committee’s decisions, the recommendations from the recent Reactive Monitoring missions, and the Third Cycle Regional Action Plan for the Arab States (2021-2027). The Work Plan furthermore foresees to support efforts to conserve and interpret sites on the Tentative List, including the inventorying and assessment of heritage values, in view of the preparation of future nomination dossiers for these sites, such as for Mosul. The Work Plan also foresees to enhance the capacities of authorities for the development of effective management systems and Management Plans for World Heritage properties that define and protect attributes of Outstanding Universal Value and sites on the Tentative List.
